items.title: Accept donations
items.detail: Your old site took donations. Connect a payment account to turn the donate button back on.

items.title: Bring your newsletter subscribers
items.detail: Sign-up forms came across, but subscribers stay with Squarespace. Export them there and import them here.

items.title: Use katieteague.com for your new site
items.detail: Your new site is live on a free address. When you're happy with it, we'll help you point katieteague.com at it — your old site keeps working until then.

items.title: Check special features
items.detail: Your old site had add-ons (chat, booking or other widgets). See which ones you still need.

items.title: Use your own font licence
items.detail: Your old site used freight-sans-pro (from Adobe Fonts), which we're not allowed to copy, so the closest free font stands in (Mukta). If you have a web licence, download the font files (WOFF2) from the font service and upload them in Site Styles → Your fonts — they're stored in media/fonts/ — then choose them for your headings and text.
